name: @activepieces/piece-hootsuite
description: Social media management — schedule posts and manage multiple networks from one dashboard.

auth.description: Connect your Hootsuite account. Create an OAuth2 app and get your client credentials at https://developer.hootsuite.com.

create_message.name: create_message
create_message.description: Schedules or immediately publishes a post to one or more social media profiles.

socialProfileIds.description: Select the social media profiles to post to.

auth.description: Connect your Hootsuite account. Create an OAuth2 app and get your client credentials at https://developer.hootsuite.com.

text.description: The text content of your post.

scheduledSendTime.description: When to publish the post (UTC, must be at least 5 minutes in the future). Leave empty to post immediately.

emailNotification.description: Send an email notification when the post is published.

aiMetadata.description: Publishes a post to one or more connected Hootsuite social profiles, either immediately or scheduled for a future time depending on whether a scheduled time is provided (leave it empty to post now; a future time must be at least 5 minutes ahead and in UTC). Use to create and distribute social media content across networks. Not idempotent: each call creates a new post, so repeating it produces duplicate posts. Requires the target social profile IDs and the post text.

get_message.name: get_message
get_message.description: Retrieves the details of a specific scheduled or published post by its ID.

messageId.description: The unique ID of the post. You can get this from a previous "Schedule Post" action output or from the Hootsuite dashboard URL.

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a single Hootsuite post by its ID and returns its current details and state (e.g. scheduled, sent, errored). Use to inspect or confirm a post created earlier or referenced from the dashboard. Idempotent read-only lookup. Requires the post ID, obtainable from a Schedule Post output or the Hootsuite dashboard URL.

delete_message.name: delete_message
delete_message.description: Permanently deletes a post. Only posts in a deletable state (e.g. SCHEDULED) can be removed.

messageId.description: The unique ID of the post to delete. You can get this from the "Schedule Post" or "Get Post Details" action.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a Hootsuite post by its ID. Use to cancel or remove a scheduled post before it sends. Only posts in a deletable state (e.g. SCHEDULED) can be removed; already-sent posts cannot. Not idempotent: the first call removes the post and subsequent calls with the same ID will fail since it no longer exists.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: Connect your Hootsuite account. Create an OAuth2 app and get your client credentials at https://developer.hootsuite.com.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description: Connect your Hootsuite account. Create an OAuth2 app and get your client credentials at https://developer.hootsuite.com.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

new_scheduled_post.name: new_scheduled_post
new_scheduled_post.description: Triggers when a new post is scheduled in Hootsuite.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new post enters the SCHEDULED state in Hootsuite, representing content queued for future publishing. Fires at scheduling time, not when the post actually sends.

sampleData.text: Check out our latest blog post!

new_published_post.name: new_published_post
new_published_post.description: Triggers when a post is published (sent) in Hootsuite.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a post transitions to the SENT state in Hootsuite, representing content that has actually been published to its social networks.

sampleData.text: Check out our latest blog post!

nl.Social media management — schedule posts: Social media management - plannen van berichten en beheren meerdere netwerken vanuit één dashboard.

nl.Retrieves the details of a specific sche: Ophalen van de details van een specifiek geplande of gepubliceerde post via de ID.
nl.Permanently deletes a post. Only posts i: Verwijdert permanent een bericht. Alleen berichten in verwijderbare toestand (bv. SCHEDULED) kunnen worden verwijderd.
nl.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Maak een aangepaste API call naar een specifiek eindpunt
nl.Select the social media profiles to post: Selecteer de social media profielen waarop u wilt posten.
nl.When to publish the post (UTC, must be a: Wanneer u de post (UTC wilt publiceren, moet ten minste 5 minuten in de toekomst zijn). Laat leeg om direct te posten.
nl.Send an email notification when the post: Stuur een e-mailnotificatie wanneer het bericht is gepubliceerd.

Inschakelen voor bestanden zoals PDF's, afbeeldingen etc.

nl.Triggers when a post is published (sent): Triggert wanneer een bericht wordt gepubliceerd (verzonden) in Hootsuite.

de.Social media management — schedule posts: Social Media Management — Planen Sie Beiträge und verwalten Sie mehrere Netzwerke von einem Dashboard.
de.Connect your Hootsuite account. Create a: Verbinden Sie Ihr Hootsuite-Konto. Erstellen Sie eine OAuth2-App und erhalten Sie Ihre Client-Zugangsdaten auf https://developer.hootsuite.com.
de.Schedules or immediately publishes a pos: Schedule oder veröffentlicht sofort einen Beitrag zu einem oder mehreren Social Media Profilen.
de.Retrieves the details of a specific sche: Ruft die Details eines bestimmten geplanten oder veröffentlichten Beitrags durch seine ID ab.
de.Permanently deletes a post. Only posts i: Löscht einen Beitrag ständig. Nur Beiträge in einem löschbaren Zustand (z.B. SCHEDULED) können entfernt werden.
de.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Einen benutzerdefinierten API-Aufruf an einen bestimmten Endpunkt machen
de.Select the social media profiles to post: Wählen Sie die sozialen Medienprofile aus, an die Sie posten möchten.
de.When to publish the post (UTC, must be a: Wenn der Beitrag veröffentlicht wird (UTC, muss mindestens 5 Minuten in der Zukunft sein). Lassen Sie leer, um sofort zu posten.
de.Send an email notification when the post: Senden Sie eine E-Mail-Benachrichtigung, wenn der Beitrag veröffentlicht wird.
de.The unique ID of the post. You can get t: Die eindeutige ID des Beitrags. Sie können diese von einer früheren Ausgabe der Aktion "Post planen" oder von der Hootsuite-Dashboard-URL erhalten.
de.The unique ID of the post to delete. You: Die eindeutige ID des zu löschenden Beitrags. Sie können diese über die Aktion "Post planen" oder "Beitragsdetails erhalten" erhalten.
de.Authorization headers are injected autom: Autorisierungs-Header werden automatisch von Ihrer Verbindung injiziert.
Aktivieren für Dateien wie PDFs, Bilder usw.

de.Triggers when a post is published (sent): Wird ausgelöst, wenn ein Beitrag in Hootsuite veröffentlicht wird (gesendet).
